claim: Web Summit says 800 speakers are coming to Lisbon.
Técnico's stand is in Pavilion 2, number E272, at Web Summit.
Técnico's stand is open from 10 to 12 November.
Li Chen is listed as a co-founder of Unitree.
Web Summit's speakers page lists Agibot A3 as a "Humanoid robot" from AGIBOT of China.
Web Summit's speakers page lists Galbot G1 as an "Embodied Large-Model Robot" from Galbot of China.
William Shi is listed as president of AgiBot Europe.
Yuli Zhao is listed as CSO of Galbot.
Técnico brings six spin-offs to its stand: Acubic, Keel, Opsivision.ai, RTBEAMTECH, RipeNew and Testwaves.
Técnico's participation at Web Summit is supported by Fundação Santander, according to the school.
